title: Reactivating moves parts to Active at once, Activate disabled if none ticked
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. On the Inactive tab with Activate parts on.
custom_steps:
1. Tick some inactive parts and confirm Activate; watch the Inactive tab, then the Active tab.
  2. Tick nothing and check the Activate button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On confirmation all selected parts move to active and leave the Inactive tab immediately (no page refresh), and appear on the Active tab.
  • With nothing ticked the Activate button is visible but disabled.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 3 (Activate parts); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R3: “When the user confirms the action, all selected parts are moved to active and removed from the Inactive tab immediately, no page refresh required.”
  • S3-R4: “The reactivated parts appear in the Active tab.”
  • S3-N1: “With nothing ticked the Activate button is visible but disabled.”
